# 3 bedroom terraced house for sale

> SUMMARY A three bedroom family home, designed over three floors, situated within close proximity to the Town Centre & Hospital. The accommodation is well presented and boasts a wealth of space and natural light throughout. Externally offering a good size enclosed rear garden with outside brick built store.

- Typ: terraced house
- Druh nabídky: sale
- Dispozice: 3 bedrooms
- Vlastnictví: Freehold
- Energetická náročnost: D
- Lokalita: Westville, Yeovil
- Cena: £200,000
